card.name: Inside immune-mediated and similar terms
card.fires_on: The hyphenated or split-up piece of "immune-mediated" ("-mediated", "ated", "iated") in immunotherapy warnings. It also fires on the middle of a few other compound terms, such as "Fertility" and "Deepwater".

modes.label: Immune-mediated
modes.description: The "-mediated" part right after "immune" when naming immune-related adverse reactions.
modes.example: Systemic corticosteroids were required in 40% (15/38) of patients with immune<<-mediated>> dermatologic adverse reactions.

modes.label: Split medical heading terms
modes.description: The end of a long term split into pieces, such as "Fertility" in a section heading.
modes.example: Carcinogenesis, Mutagenesis, Impairment of F<<ertility>> Rats treated with nicardipine

modes.label: Deepwater Horizon
modes.description: The "water" piece inside the rig name Deepwater Horizon in news text.
modes.example: the massive explosion that destroyed the Deep<<water>> Horizon drilling rig on April 20
